notes.title: Big Update Soon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225519/8d5c9810e516a68f1ccdcf9e9367f21525b13c8b.png[/img]
Hey everyone, Sebastian here! I've been working on a completely rebuilt version of the launcher that will bring some major new features to A Buttload of Free Games!

Not wanting to spoil all the surprises, I will say that the biggest feature being added is Steamworks integration. This means that once Launcher 3.0.0 launches there will be Steam Achievements for the game(s)!

There is one small downside to adding achievements to a live product though: there will likely be a range of time where you will see the achievements live but be unable to obtain them. Just know that they will be accessible as soon as 3.0.0 launches, which there will be a major announcement for displayed in the game's spotlight. It'll be hard to miss! I just ask your understanding if there are a few hours between achievements going public and the new update launching where the achievements are visible but not unlockable.

There are a ton of other quality of life updates coming with the new launcher version as well as a couple surprises so look forward to it soon!

As thanks for reading all this here's a sneak peek at the visual revamp of the launcher:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225519/b111f0d3dc85b744841544a3971a9f17c4107cd2.png[/img]

tags.feature: Not wanting to spoil all the surprises, I will say that the biggest feature being added is Steamworks integration.
This means that once Launcher 3.0.0 launches there will be Steam Achievements for the game(s)!

notes.title: You Can't See Everything at Once +
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225519/653022d3532a19544068e98e35a1d8d7e403459f.gif[/img]
[h1]About[/h1]
An all new and expanded version of You Can't See Everything at Once featuring double the levels, a new original soundtrack and sounds, online leaderboards, and dozens of quality of life changes.

You Can't See Everything at Once + is a speedrunning focused hardcore platformer where you have to choose between seeing yourself and the level. Try to beat the game as fast as you can and compare your score to the rest of the world!

notes.title: Launcher 2.0.0
notes.content:
A Buttload of Free Games Launcher 2.0.0 is available now! This major update brings new UI art by Del Nordlund, new sounds by Patrick Flattery and many much needed quality of life changes!

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added sound effects to launcher buttons.
[*] Added a settings screen and sound settings.
[*] Added new button art.
[*] Added launcher credits.
[*] Prevented opening multiple Before You Play windows at once.
[*] Prevented Before You Play windows from opening the wrong game should the game be changed before it is closed.
[*] Added short descriptors to each game.
[*] Added a Before You Play popup to Sqaranch!
[*] Redesigned launcher layout.
[*] Updated launcher intro scene.
[/list]
